name: Patron EG
summary: Filament brand marketed as PATRON (SpoolmanDB 'Patron EG'), known from a marble PLA line sold by an Alexandria, Egypt reseller at 780 EGP/kg. Likely an Egyptian local or private-label brand; owner and manufacturer unknown.

product_lines.name: Marble PLA
product_lines.notes: White, Mocha, Baby Blue and Turquoise Marble; 1.75 mm +/-0.03 mm, 1 kg; 780 EGP. Product page labels it PLA+ while SpoolmanDB says PLA, so pla-plus is not asserted.

additional_notes: Egyptian origin is inferred from the 'EG' suffix and the Egyptian reseller (Makers Electronics, Alexandria) and is unconfirmed, so headquarters_country is omitted. No official website or social accounts found.

provenance.conflicts: Single reseller page; PLA vs PLA+ disagreement between reseller and SpoolmanDB; country inferred only.
